verses.en: Remember, O LORD, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.
verses.pt: Lembra-te, Senhor, do que nos tem sucedido; considera, e olha para o nosso opróbrio.
verses.en_web: Remember, Yahweh, what has come on us. Look, and see our reproach.
verses.en_bbe: Keep in mind, O Lord, what has come to us: take note and see our shame.

verses.en: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.
verses.pt: A nossa herdade passou a estranhos, e as nossas casas a forasteiros.
verses.en_web: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our houses to aliens.
verses.en_bbe: Our heritage is given up to men of strange lands, our houses to those who are not our countrymen.

verses.en: We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers are as widows.
verses.pt: çrfãos somos sem pai, nossas mães são como viuvas.
verses.en_web: We are orphans and fatherless. Our mothers are as widows.
verses.en_bbe: We are children without fathers, our mothers are like widows.

verses.en: We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us.
verses.pt: A nossa água por dinheiro a bebemos, por preço vem a nossa lenha.
verses.en_web: We have drunken our water for money. Our wood is sold to us.
verses.en_bbe: We give money for a drink of water, we get our wood for a price.

verses.en: Our necks are under persecution: we labour, and have no rest.
verses.pt: Os nossos perseguidores estão sobre os nossos pescoços; estamos cansados, e não temos descanso.
verses.en_web: Our pursuers are on our necks. We are weary, and have no rest.
verses.en_bbe: Our attackers are on our necks: overcome with weariness, we have no rest.

verses.en: We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
verses.pt: Aos egípcios e aos assírios estendemos as mãos, para nos fartarmos de pão.
verses.en_web: We have given our hands to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
verses.en_bbe: We have given our hands to the Egyptians and to the Assyrians so that we might have enough bread.

verses.en: Our fathers have sinned, and are not; and we have borne their iniquities.
verses.pt: Nossos pais pecaram, e já não existem; e nós levamos as suas iniqüidades.
verses.en_web: Our fathers sinned, and are no more. We have borne their iniquities.
verses.en_bbe: Our fathers were sinners and are dead; and the weight of their evil-doing is on us.

verses.en: Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.
verses.pt: Escravos dominam sobre nós; ninguém há que nos arranque da sua mão.
verses.en_web: Servants rule over us. There is no one to deliver us out of their hand.
verses.en_bbe: Servants are ruling over us, and there is no one to make us free from their hands.

verses.en: We gat our bread with the peril of our lives because of the sword of the wilderness.
verses.pt: Com perigo de nossas vidas obtemos o nosso pão, por causa da espada do deserto.
verses.en_web: We get our bread at the peril of our lives, because of the sword of the wilderness.
verses.en_bbe: We put our lives in danger to get our bread, because of the sword of the waste land.

verses.en: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.
verses.pt: Nossa pele está abraseada como um forno, por causa do ardor da fome.
verses.en_web: Our skin is black like an oven, because of the burning heat of famine.
verses.en_bbe: Our skin is heated like an oven because of our burning heat from need of food.

verses.en: They ravished the women in Zion, and the maids in the cities of Judah.
verses.pt: Forçaram as mulheres em Sião, as virgens nas cidades de Judá.
verses.en_web: They ravished the women in Zion, the virgins in the cities of Judah.
verses.en_bbe: They took by force the women in Zion, the virgins in the towns of Judah.

verses.en: Princes are hanged up by their hand: the faces of elders were not honoured.
verses.pt: Príncipes foram enforcados pelas mãos deles; as faces dos anciãos não foram respeitadas.
verses.en_web: Princes were hanged up by their hands. The faces of elders were not honored.
verses.en_bbe: Their hands put princes to death by hanging: the faces of old men were not honoured.

verses.en: They took the young men to grind, and the children fell under the wood.
verses.pt: Mancebos levaram a mó; meninos tropeçaram sob fardos de lenha.
verses.en_web: The young men carry millstones. The children stumbled under loads of wood.
verses.en_bbe: The young men were crushing the grain, and the boys were falling under the wood.

verses.en: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their musick.
verses.pt: Os velhos já não se assentam nas portas, os mancebos já não cantam.
verses.en_web: The elders have ceased from the gate, and the young men from their music.
verses.en_bbe: The old men are no longer seated in the doorway, and the music of the young men has come to an end.

verses.en: The joy of our heart is ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.
verses.pt: Cessou o gozo de nosso coração; converteu-se em lamentação a nossa dança.
verses.en_web: The joy of our heart has ceased. Our dance is turned into mourning.
verses.en_bbe: The joy of our hearts is ended; our dancing is changed into sorrow.

verses.en: The crown is fallen from our head: woe unto us, that we have sinned!
verses.pt: Caiu a coroa da nossa cabeça; ai de nós. porque pecamos.
verses.en_web: The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!
verses.en_bbe: The crown has been taken from our head: sorrow is ours, for we are sinners.

verses.en: For this our heart is faint; for these things our eyes are dim.
verses.pt: Portanto desmaiou o nosso coração; por isso se escureceram os nossos olhos.
verses.en_web: For this our heart is faint. For these things our eyes are dim.
verses.en_bbe: Because of this our hearts are feeble; for these things our eyes are dark;

verses.en: Because of the mountain of Zion, which is desolate, the foxes walk upon it.
verses.pt: Pelo monte de Sião, que está assolado, andam os chacais.
verses.en_web: For the mountain of Zion, which is desolate. The foxes walk on it.
verses.en_bbe: Because of the mountain of Zion which is a waste; jackals go over it.

verses.en: Thou, O LORD, remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.
verses.pt: Tu, Senhor, permaneces eternamente; e o teu trono subsiste de geração em geração.
verses.en_web: You, Yahweh, remain forever. Your throne is from generation to generation.
verses.en_bbe: You, O Lord, are seated as King for ever; the seat of your power is eternal.

verses.en: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever, and forsake us so long time?
verses.pt: Por que te esquecerias de nós para sempre, por que nos desampararias por tanto tempo?
verses.en_web: Why do you forget us forever, and forsake us for so long a time?
verses.en_bbe: Why have we gone from your memory for ever? why have you been turned away from us for so long?

verses.en: Turn thou us unto thee, O LORD, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.
verses.pt: Converte-nos a ti, Senhor, e seremos convertidos; renova os nossos dias como dantes;
verses.en_web: Turn us to yourself, Yahweh, and we will be turned. Renew our days as of old.
verses.en_bbe: Make us come back to you, O Lord, and let us be turned; make our days new again as in the past.

verses.en: But thou hast utterly rejected us; thou art very wroth against us.
verses.pt: se é que não nos tens de todo rejeitado, se é que não estás sobremaneira irado contra nos.
verses.en_web: But you have utterly rejected us. You are very angry against us.
verses.en_bbe: But you have quite given us up; you are full of wrath against us.
